findings.title: Missing cache re-check after acquiring write lock causes thundering herd and I/O under exclusive lock
findings.body: After the initial RLock sees entryPointAssetsCache == nil, the function takes the write lock and immediately performs readWebAssetsFromFile/CDN without re-reading entryPointAssetsCache. Multiple goroutines that all observed nil will therefore serialize on the write lock and each recompute and overwrite the cache, while all other GetWebAssets callers are blocked. Add a second check for a non-nil cache after acquiring the write lock (or use singleflight) before doing I/O.

findings.title: No concurrent test for the race fix
findings.body: The PR changes shared-state synchronization but adds no test that exercises GetWebAssets concurrently. A test invoking GetWebAssets from multiple goroutines (run under the race detector) would verify both that the cache assignment is race-free and that the cache population path behaves correctly under contention.
